units.source_text: 不一会儿，一位母亲牵着一个刚剃了头、脑袋蛮大的五六岁男孩过桥来了。

en.t: Before long, a mother came across the bridge leading a five- or six-year-old boy who had just had his head shaved and had a rather large head.

units.source_text: 母亲回家比往常晚，孩子到工厂接她来了。

en.t: His mother was later than usual getting home, so the child had come to the factory to meet her.
